news.title: Cross-chain protocol Chainflip's FLIP tanks 30% after suspected $4.86 million vault drain
news.summary: The withdrawal carried a valid signature, which Onchain Lens said points to a possible compromise of the key validators use to approve vault payouts.

news.title: Ether treasury firm BTCS warns SEC its $54 million Aave loan could be liquidated
news.summary: BTCS cut its reported Aave debt by about $10 million in ten days, but falling ether prices are keeping its collateral under pressure.
